snippet.title: Call of the Elder Gods - Story Trailer - FGS Live From gamescom
snippet.description:
Journey to the far corners of the Earth and unearth ancient horrors in Lovecraftian narrative puzzle adventure, Call of the Elder Gods - a sequel to 2020’s Call of the Sea. It's coming soon to PC and consoles. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #calloftheelderbuffs
